releasesInRange.name: React Spectrum S2 1.8.0
releasesInRange.body:
This release introduces the new SideNavPanel component, adds async and virtualized support for Menu, and brings several exciting updates to React Spectrum's AI components!

[Full Release Notes](https://react-spectrum.adobe.com/releases/v1-8-0)

releasesInRange.name: React Aria Components v1.22.0
releasesInRange.body:
This release introduces [Sheet](https://react-aria.adobe.com/Sheet), a swipeable overlay that slides in from the edge of the viewport, built on native browser scroll gestures. This component is perfect for implementing touch-friendly trays such as mobile sheets, navigation drawers, and notification banners. Check out our [blog post](https://react-aria.adobe.com/blog/sheet) about how it works!

It also adds Turbopack support to @react-aria/optimize-locales-plugin, overlay placement that accounts for the virtual keyboard, and much more!

As always, many thanks to all of our contributors!

[Full Release Notes](https://react-aria.adobe.com/releases/v1-22-0)
